name: Sumo Stance

card.plain: Hold the special's button before it fires: the longer you hold, the faster you dash in, up to a top speed.
card.frames: Hold 6-30 ticks; dash 6 / 10 / 14 / 18 units per tick through startup (top speed 18)

notes: AM11 (decided 2026-10-20): holding gives a faster dash and nothing is added to damage; no new animation (A10), the hold plays an existing clip (ryo-crouch, as the engine test fixture does; there is no Kappa crouch clip, presentation only). Engine: YOK-171 (ChargeSpec). window_ticks min 6 / max 30 (a release below 6 starts the special with no dash, reaching 30 starts it at once); step_ticks 8 (step = held / 8, so a hold of 6-7 ticks is step 0, 8-15 step 1, 16-23 step 2, 24-30 step 3); dash speeds 6 / 10 / 14 / 18 gameplay units per tick through the special's startup frames, capped at 18. Integers only (F3). Every number is a first pass, marked proposed: the rules give none. A dash of 18 per tick over River Grab's 6 startup frames is 108 units, over Shell Spin's 10 frames 180. Applies to any special except a projectile. Locked (A11, the diamond). OPEN with the designer: YOK-210 (the hold behaviour built in PR #244) and what the Tanuki does when it copies a charged special (T4, rules.md open questions). Same data in Kata and Kihon (K3). Effect from the rules.md modifiers table and AM11.
